content:
It has long been an annoying me that kunit tests do not fail when lockdep triggers during a test, or if a test is sleeping in unsleepable context. I use kunit extensively before submitting patches, and some times I miss problems because the kunit tooling hides the warnings behind the pretty kunit interface. A colleague of mine has propsed a fix for this now https://lore.kernel.org/all/20260818-lockdep-kunit-v1-0-66ceb1a272e3@gmail.com/

Any thoughts?
